info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Relationship Management API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Relationship Management API facilitates the retrieval of essential information related to the relationships with correspondent banks. This API allows users to access detailed insights about various agencies involved in banking collaborations, making it crucial for financial institutions managing international transfers. Typical consumers of this API include compliance officers, relationship managers, and financial analysts who require up-to-date data to support their operations. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their understanding of correspondent relationships, ensuring improved decision-making and risk management.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific correspondent bank relationship based on the provided unique identifier. This endpoint allows users to access relevant information about the correspondent bank relationship for better management and oversight.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve details regarding the correspondent bank relationship management for the specified resource. It is essential to provide the necessary parameters to ensure accurate data retrieval.
